'''Financial Wizards''' are NPCs that only appear in [[Deadman Mode]] and are located in or near banks. Players can give them ten individual items that they wish to keep safe; when the 10 items are given to the Financial Wizards, they are securely stored in the Safe Deposit Box and cannot be used nor lost on death.

Safe deposit-box can not be accessed while [[Skull (status)|skulled]].

[[File:Deadman_mode_-_Safe_Deposit_Box.png|thumb|left|The Safe Deposit Box, accessed by visiting a Financial Wizard.]]
You cannot store untradeable items. Stackable items such as bank notes, runes, arrows, bolts, etc. will not count as one item. For example, 10 [[air rune]]s will count as 10 items.

'''Deadman starter packs''' are crates obtained from [[Brugsen Bursen]] and the [[Melee combat tutor|melee]], [[magic combat tutor|magic]], or [[ranged combat tutor]]s in seasonal [[Deadman Mode]]. They are obtained on death if not toggled off, and cannot be brought to [[Entrana]]. 11 free inventory spaces are required to open it.

The pack contains the following items:
*[[Starter sword]]
*[[Starter bow]]
*[[Starter staff]]
*12 [[Tuna (Deadman starter pack)|tunas]]
*[[Chronicle]] with 10 charges added to it
*[[Deadman's chest]]
*[[Deadman's legs]]
*[[Starter cape]]
*[[Dramen staff]]
*[[Deadman's skull]]

'''Financial Seers''' act as [[Financial Wizard]]s in [[Neitiznot]], only appearing in [[Deadman Mode]] and located in the bank. Players can give them ten items that they wish to keep safe; when the 10 items are given to the Financial Seer, they are securely stored in the Safe Deposit Box and cannot be used.
[[File:Deadman_mode_-_Safe_Deposit_Box.png|thumb|left|The Safe Deposit Box, accessed by visiting the Financial Seer.]]
Players cannot store untradeable items. Stackable items such as bank notes, runes, arrows, bolts, etc. will not count as one item. For example, 10 [[air rune]]s will count as 10 items.
